question.worked_solution:
First, let's swap the left and right-hand sides so that the variable is on the left-hand side.

$$
\frac{a}{9}=-3
$$

In this equation, $a$ is being divided by $9.$ To isolate $a$, we can perform the opposite operation, which is *multiplying* by $9.$ So, we multiply both sides of the equation by $9$ and simplify.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{a}{9} & =-3 \\ 9\cdot \frac{a}{9} & =9\cdot (-3) \\ \frac{9a}{9} & =-27 \\ \frac{\cancel{9}a}{\cancel{9}} & =-27 \\ a & =-27\end{aligned}
$$
